zw_marsh.why: M1: packs of 4–5 黄泉の火 (wisp_4, AoE magic 4/7 of its actions) took 16–20% of the party HP per battle; from T6 the pack is 2–3 wisps with 1–2 lizardmen.

z_r_marsh_bog.why: M1: packs of 4–5 黄泉の火 (wisp_4) — from T6 the pack is 2–3 wisps with 1–2 frogs.

z_r_marsh_manor.why: M5: average strength was 2.96–2.99 (< 3.0) → ghost 2–3 → 2–4; L6: 冥界の霊王 (ghost_5) 0.61 → 0.70 per battle; M1: from T6 the wisp pack is 2–3 黄泉の火 with 1–2 dolls.

z_finale_archive_lo.why: §9.13.3 L6: 呪いの書 (book_2, T8 set) 0.46 → 0.72 per battle: book_2 3–4 weight 7 → 12.

z_finale_archive_hi.why: §9.13.3 L6: four T8-set species live here (白衣の写本師 scribe_2, 白衣の司書長 scribe_3, 白紙の書 book_3, 忘れられた魔兵 demon_1: 0.57/0.26/0.51/0.34 per battle) → rebuilt so each is met ≥0.65 per battle (average strength 3.33).

z_postgame_oblivion_hi.why: M5: a lone 混沌の祖獣 (strength 1.8) was below the 2.2 group minimum → with one 虚無の騎士 (2.8).
